bullets.text: Built and deployed a full construction job management platform (React, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL) for a managed client to replace their JobTread subscription, delivered end-to-end as part of MSP work.
Managed full project lifecycle: client requirements meetings, frontend/backend development, Linux VPS deployment, and ongoing feature iteration.
Built budgeting, KPI dashboards, drag-and-drop budget groups, e-signature workflows, and a customer document portal with PDF generation for invoices, proposals, contracts, and change orders.
Implemented Microsoft SSO (Azure AD) as the sole authentication method, validating ID tokens against Microsoft's JWKS endpoint and restricting sign-in to approved tenant IDs.

Built a token-based customer portal (UUID-keyed, no login required) for document viewing, approval, and payment, and encrypted sensitive data at rest (AES) for stored property entry codes to reduce breach risk.

Integrated QuickBooks API for invoice sync and built an incoming payment webhook to automatically mark invoices paid once a customer pays through the portal; migrated all operational data (customers, jobs, documents, expenses) from the legacy system into PostgreSQL.

Deployed and maintained production infrastructure on a Linux VPS: Caddy reverse proxy with automatic TLS, systemd-managed Node.js service, firewall configuration, automated daily PostgreSQL backups with 14-day rotation, and production troubleshooting.
Built Azure Video Indexing-based tooling for automated scene classification and searchable analysis across large surveillance footage datasets.
Cloud AI interviewer (LLM + STT + TTS) built with Streamlit and OpenAI; delegates compute to cloud for low-spec deployment.
Modular service layer (llm_service, stt_service, tts_service) with pluggable provider architecture and one-command cross-platform startup scripts.
Privacy-focused offline variant using Ollama (on-device LLM) and Faster Whisper (local STT) for full data control.
Drop-in compatible with the online variant; lazy resource initialization reduces startup latency and memory footprint.
Built a React/Vite dashboard at PanaceaLogics to automate Freelancer.com client data extraction, track bid success rates, and calculate team commissions.
Chained project ID to owner ID to client profile API lookups to surface contact details normally hidden until a client responds to a bid.
Deployed to GitHub Pages with shift-aware commission tracking and personalized outreach template generation.
Built a Streamlit app for bulk WhatsApp outreach via CSV upload with per-minute scheduling, rate-limit handling, and personalized {name} templates.
Used internally for internship candidate shortlisting and business outreach automation.
Client-side web app to parse Meezan Bank CSVs, categorize expenses, and visualize spending trends with interactive charts.
Visualizes project file structures with ASCII art, code statistics, GitHub repo integration, and interactive tree controls.
